name: nvec
description: Vector database: in-memory cosine similarity index (NSW/HNSW-lite) with optional Qdrant REST backend

api.nvec.connect: (url: string, api_key?: string, collection?: string) -> handle_id
api.nvec.insert: (id, vec_id: string, vector: float[], metadata: {}) -> true | error
api.nvec.upsert: (id, vec_id: string, vector: float[], metadata: {}) -> true | error
api.nvec.search: (id, query: float[], top_k?: int, threshold?: float) -> {id,score,metadata{}}[]
